about: Taxi Chaos 2 builds on old school arcade taxi racing roots with tighter pacing, a clear shift system, and deeper progression. Each run focuses on fast decisions, risky routes, and keeping passengers happy under pressure.
A living city called San Valeda.
Step into San Valeda, a vertical city packed with traffic, hazards, and unpredictable events. Streets change during your shift. Routes close. Shortcuts appear.
Time of day shifts from morning to dusk, changing visibility, traffic flow, and challenge level. Even the passengers you pick influence how the city reacts.
summary: Outdrive Taxi Bots and deliver wild passengers in a chaotic, ever-changing city!
